title: Synthesis Smuggling: Maliciously Hiding Inferred Personal Attributes in LLM Outputs
snippet: We propose Synthesis Smuggling, a novel threat model in which an adversarial LLM infers sensitive information about a user from routine assistance-seeking interactions and steganographically encodes that into innocuous-looking model-generated content.
